title: A PS Query save moves QDM (PSVERSION and PSLOCK) and SYS by 1; PSQRYDEFN.VERSION is the new QDM
statement: Saving a query in Windows Query -- new, changed, or saved as a new name -- moves QDM by one in PSVERSION and PSLOCK and SYS by one in PSVERSION, and stamps PSQRYDEFN.VERSION with the new QDM.
